🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: heavy Tech leadership (QCOM, INTC, META, AMD ABOVE TREND) offset by broad sector weakness (Financials, Energy, Utilities negative) and multiple 1W/1M divergences, producing mixed signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare next: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY. Materials showing mild strength: select names outperforming within the group.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate soft: CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND; WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); Style: Growth/Momentum tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND; FDX (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND; SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND; VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION; PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Utilities/Industrials/Financials/Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65%), INTC (1W: +13.26%), META (1W: +12.99%), AMD (1W: +12.65%), WBD (1W: +11.01%). Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M: SHOP, AMGN, LLY) — watch for trend break; treat rallies as tactical until breadth confirms.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but internally strong: AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.53% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.61% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND. Technology 1W +3.08% but leadership narrow; monitor breadth before adding exposure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak overall: JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND. Financials 1W -1.08% and showing internal pressure; selective names with news catalysts merit monitoring.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive tone: JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY. Healthcare 1W +1.60% — watch drug approvals/news for directional follow-through.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Tech leaders (QCOM, INTC, META) and monitor Healthcare names with confirmed catalysts; reduce exposure to lagging Utilities and broad Financials pressure. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but leadership is narrow — be selective and size defensively until breadth improves.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through candidate; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND — momentum. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed; CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND — at risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W +3.08%) — watch whether leadership broadens. BEARISH: Energy (1W -3.68%) and Utilities (1W -2.70%) — monitor sentiment-driven volatility and earnings/news.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch QCOM for continuation of breakout on heavy volume (ABOVE TREND confirmation). Monitor META for daily follow-through above this week’s highs (ABOVE TREND momentum). Flag ORCL breach levels and CHTR downside acceleration (both BELOW TREND) as triggers to reduce exposure.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WBD (+85): WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — large M&A headline confirming price strength. NVDA (+50): NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND — positive China chip chatter aligns with accumulation. LLY (+50): LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY — bullish GLP‑1 commentary may fuel further follow-through but 1M lag remains. CVX (+50): CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) CORRECTION — price short-term soft despite constructive headlines.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-45): ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — negative coverage confirmed by price decline. CHTR (-50): CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both weak. BA (-55): BA (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — operational headlines aligning with downside. MPC (-50): MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines but 1M strength suggests tactical divergence.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated Tech leadership and mixed sector internals. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and multiple 1W/1M divergences (SHOP, AMGN, LLY) — watch for trend breaks and confirm with broadened sector breadth.
